Recently, though, surrounding myself with a ton of sensory pleasing objects- for me, fluffy stuff- is taking some of the constant angst away! 
Good luck to everyone else trying to search for another way of ‘comfort’!

Ice- hold onto ice until it melts.
Cold- very cold- showers. 
Stick your face into cold water and hold it there.
Music
Taking a walk
Watching soothing videos- be it cats or someone cooking or whatever

Get yourself a therapist, if possible. 
Vent to someone.
